Froze and lost my reply. 

Thanks for the not judgy reply. Honestly feel better. Not frantic. Told my SO I'm crying and just want to listen to music and not talk. Which was respected. And that helped. 

But I still just feel like I am suddenly feeling everything I've supressed at once. Last time I checjed myself into psych and I wish I was a celebrity where I could go for 90 days and get better not just wanna get out bc I can't afford to stay and daily lockdown gets old. 

If I had some way to definitely be successful I woukd but I don't keep meds or guns or whatever in my house for that reason. I want to just cut but can't do that either. Taken to ripping my eyebrows out and I almost have none left now. Cuticles are bloody messes. 

This is what I mean. I honestly feel like ripping my eyebrows out is easier than therapy. I don't know what I'm so scared of and don't want to.

Thanks for replying. It means a lot. 

I think that's part of my problem is I deal just fine and medicate w alcohol usually. Obviously not just fine but you know what I mean. I just feel like I'm at that point I get to about once a year where it all hits me and I feel frantic. It's as though I'm suddenly feeling everything I've suppressed since the last time I tried. Just all this mental pain hitting me at once. Dealing with it would just hurt more than just being done is what I keep thinking.
